title.narrative: AGF Innovation and Entrepreneurship on climate and environment

description.narrative:
The project goal is to improve access to credit for micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) which have the potential to scale up innovations in the following sectors: food security, blue economy, marine litter, renewable energy and clean cooking solutions, and aquaculture. The project will operate over four years (2024 - 2027) in Sub-Saharan Africa, with priority to Kenya, Tanzania, Mozambique, Ghana and Malawi.
To achieve this goal, AGF will offer the following products: Financial Guarantees will be provided to Partner Financial Institutions (PFls), to reduce their potential credit losses and therefore increase their appetite to finance MSMEs. These guarantees will cover up to 75% of the PFI exposure on loans to MSMEs operating in the above-mentioned sectors. Volume of lending targeted toward women owned/led MSMEs are 30 per cent.
Capacity Development support will be provided to PFls and MSMEs through Capacity Development Partners. For PFls, the support will focus on product development, market research, risk management, customer service and any other activities that will help them mitigate risks or develop their pipeline. For MSMEs, the support will focus on bookkeeping, cash-flow management, and other business skills, helping them to reduce information asymmetry, and thus improving risk perception and its related costs and building a pipeline of creditworthy MSMEs for the PFls.
